name: FrequentlyBuy – Bought Together Upsells for WooCommerce
author: themelooks

sections.description:
FrequentlyBuy is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that helps store owners increase average order value by displaying frequently bought together products directly on the product page.

With flexible display positions, product selection modes, and category-based controls, you can easily create smart product bundles and upsell related items without complex setup.

The plugin works seamlessly with WooCommerce products and provides full control over where and how frequently bought together products appear.

✨ Features:

  • Flexible Display Position

    • Display FrequentlyBuy products before the Add to Cart button
    • Display FrequentlyBuy products after the Add to Cart button
  • Display Control Options

    • Show FrequentlyBuy products on all products
    • Show on individual selected products only
    • Show based on product categories
  • Individual Product Selection

    • Select specific products where FrequentlyBuy items should be displayed
    • Full control over product-level visibility
  • Category-Based Display

    • Choose one or more product categories
    • Automatically show FrequentlyBuy products on all products within selected categories
  • Quantity Display Control

    • Option to hide or show quantity field for FrequentlyBuy products
    • Useful for add-on–style products
  • Product Selection Mode

    • Checkbox mode – allow customers to select multiple add-on products
    • Radio mode – allow customers to select only one product from the list
  • Add-On Product Support

    • Mark products as add-ons
    • Customers can easily add selected FrequentlyBuy products to the cart together with the main product
  • WooCommerce Compatible

    • Works with standard WooCommerce add-to-cart flow
    • Compatible with AJAX and non-AJAX add-to-cart behavior

🎯 Benefits

  • Increase average order value
  • Improve product discoverability
  • Encourage upsells and cross-sells
  • Simple setup with flexible configuration
  • No impact on WooCommerce core functionality
sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “FrequentlyBuy”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, FrequentlyBuy Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “FrequentlyBuy WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible on latest wordpress ?

Yes
